about: The Ultimate Challenge's own rounds: never played on the Board or in Defuse. Cambridge formats only, written around the traps B2 First actually sets.

rounds.prompt: If I ___ more time, I'd learn to play the guitar.
rounds.note: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + verb.

rounds.prompt: If she hadn't missed the train, she ___ with us right now.
rounds.note: Mixed: a past cause (hadn't missed) with a present result (would be … now).

rounds.prompt: If you ___ water to 100°C, it boils.
rounds.note: Zero conditional: present + present for facts.

rounds.prompt: ___ you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
rounds.note: unless = if … not.

rounds.prompt: I'll lend you my laptop ___ you give it back by Friday.
rounds.note: as long as = only if.

rounds.prompt: I'll take my jacket ___ it gets cold later.
rounds.note: in case: a precaution, because it might happen.

rounds.prompt: If I had known you were ill, I ___ you some soup.
rounds.note: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.

rounds.prompt: If he ___ more carefully last night, he wouldn't have crashed.
rounds.note: Third conditional: the if-clause takes the past perfect.

rounds.prompt: If I were taller, I ___ join the basketball team.
rounds.note: Second conditional with could: an unreal ability.

rounds.prompt: Suppose you ___ the lottery, what would you do?
rounds.note: suppose + past simple with would: an imaginary present or future.

rounds.prompt: I wish I ___ how to swim. I'd love to go surfing.
rounds.note: wish + past simple for a present situation you'd like to change.

rounds.prompt: If only I ___ to the doctor sooner!
rounds.note: If only + past perfect for a past regret.

rounds.prompt: She won't come ___ you invite her personally.
rounds.note: won't … unless = won't … if you don't.

rounds.prompt: If you see Ana, ___ her I said hello.
rounds.note: if + present, then an imperative.

rounds.prompt: What would you do if you ___ a wallet in the street?
rounds.note: Second conditional: if + past simple.

rounds.prompt: ___ for the goalkeeper, we would have lost.
rounds.note: But for = If it hadn't been for.

rounds.prompt: If I ___ you, I'd tell her the truth.
rounds.note: If I were you … (was is common in speech; were is the standard form).

rounds.prompt: We'll miss the start ___ we leave right now.
rounds.note: unless = if we don't.

rounds.prompt: If you had told me, I would ___ helped you.
rounds.note: would have + past participle.

rounds.prompt: You can borrow my bike as ___ as you're careful with it.
rounds.note: as long as = on condition that.

rounds.prompt: If the alarm ___ gone off, I'd still be asleep.
rounds.note: Mixed: past cause (hadn't gone off), present result (I'd still be).

rounds.prompt: ___ you rich, would you still work?
rounds.note: Were you rich = If you were rich.

rounds.prompt: I'll wait here ___ case you need me.
rounds.note: in case: as a precaution.

rounds.prompt: What ___ you do if you lost your phone?
rounds.note: Second conditional question: What would you do if …?

rounds.prompt: ___ only I had saved some money!
rounds.note: If only + past perfect for a regret.

rounds.prompt: If it ___ not been for the rain, we'd have won.
rounds.note: If it had not been for = without.

rounds.prompt: Even ___ he apologises, I won't forgive him.
rounds.note: even if: the result doesn't change whatever happens.

rounds.prompt: I wish you ___ stop talking during the film!
rounds.note: wish + would for an annoying habit you want to stop.

rounds.prompt: Let's leave now, ___ we'll be late.
rounds.note: otherwise / or = if we don't.

rounds.prompt: Provided ___ the weather is good, we'll eat outside.
rounds.note: provided (that) = only if.

rounds.prompt: I didn't study, so I failed the exam.
rounds.stem: If I ___, I wouldn't have failed the exam.
rounds.note: Third conditional: if + past perfect.

rounds.prompt: I can't go to the concert because I don't have a ticket.
rounds.stem: I could go to the concert ___ a ticket.
rounds.note: Second conditional: could go … if I had.

rounds.prompt: You won't pass unless you work harder.
rounds.note: unless = if … not.

rounds.prompt: Hurry up or you'll miss the bus.
rounds.note: or = unless.

rounds.prompt: I regret not buying that jacket.
rounds.note: wish + past perfect for a past regret.

rounds.prompt: It's a pity I can't speak Japanese.
rounds.note: wish + could / past simple for the present.

rounds.prompt: You can use my phone, but only if you're careful.
rounds.stem: You can use my phone ___ careful.
rounds.note: only if = as long as.

rounds.prompt: Without your help, I would have failed.
rounds.stem: If it ___ your help, I would have failed.
rounds.note: Without = If it hadn't been for.

rounds.prompt: I'll take some money because I might need a taxi.
rounds.stem: I'll take some money ___ a taxi.
rounds.note: because I might = in case.

rounds.prompt: If she happens to call, tell her I'm out.
rounds.note: Should she call = If she happens to call.

rounds.prompt: He's tired because he went to bed late.
rounds.stem: If he hadn't gone to bed late, he ___.
rounds.note: Mixed: past cause, present result.

rounds.prompt: I'm sorry I said that to her.
rounds.note: If only + past perfect.

rounds.prompt: Imagine you won a million euros. What would you buy?
rounds.stem: ___ a million euros, what would you buy?
rounds.note: Suppose + past simple = imagine.

rounds.prompt: We didn't go out because it was raining.
rounds.stem: We would have gone out ___ raining.
rounds.note: Third conditional with the continuous: if it hadn't been raining.

rounds.prompt: Your parents will let you go only if you finish your homework.
rounds.stem: Your parents will let you go ___ your homework.
rounds.note: only if = provided (that).

rounds.prompt: I don't have a car, so I can't drive you home.
rounds.stem: If I had a car, I ___ home.
rounds.note: Second conditional result: would + verb.
